title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS (BOAC) and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to approving the proposed Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126…
text:
[Council File 24-1429-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS (BOAC) and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to approving the proposed Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126 with HNTB Corporation, for office space in the Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA)-owned Skyview Center, located at 6033 West Century Boulevard.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' action of October 14, 2026, adopting the determination that the proposed action is categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article III, Class 1(18)(c) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126 with HNTB Corporation, pursuant to Board of Airport Commissioners Resolution No. 28486, to expand the leased premises at 6033 West Century Boulevard.
3. CONCUR with the BOAC's action on October 14, 2026, by Resolution 28486, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, LAWA, or designee, to execute said Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126 with HNTB Corporation, subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that approval of this item will result in net revenue of $3,196,105 to LAWA over the 88 -month term after broker commissions and tenant improvements are deducted. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Trade, Travel, and Tourism Committee has waived consideration of this matter.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 14, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 13, 2026
